يتحاشيا (form VI)
# يَتَحَاشَيَا (yataḥāšayā) /ja.ta.ħaː.ʃa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
# يُتَحَاشَيَا (yutaḥāšayā) /ju.ta.ħaː.ʃa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
